mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal broad economic contraction in demand and supply, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) increases cost of capital and suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising non-farm payroll trend (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 500,000 units (HOUST < 500) signals housing sector contraction that reduces economic activity and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 500, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signal stagflation that erodes corporate margins and consumer confidence, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and UNRATE > 9.0, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.
